data.description:
Compute the holdout set from incidents.jsonl and remove RED markers for both corpus fixtures.

File to create:
- tests/fixtures/inference-incidents/holdout.txt

Holdout partition rule: include ticket_id where hash(ticket_id) mod 3 == 0.
Hash function: Python hashlib.md5(ticket_id.encode()).hexdigest(), convert first 8 hex chars to int, then mod 3.
This must be documented in the file header (e.g., # holdout: md5(ticket_id)[0:8] as int mod 3 == 0) for reproducibility.

Steps:
1. For each ticket_id in incidents.jsonl, compute md5 hash, take first 8 hex chars as int, mod 3
2. Write ticket_ids where result == 0 to holdout.txt (one per line)
3. Remove RED markers for incidents.jsonl and holdout.txt from .test-index

AC: holdout.txt exists. Every ticket_id in holdout.txt satisfies the md5 modulo condition. Every ticket_id in holdout.txt appears in incidents.jsonl. tests/docs/test-inference-incident-corpus.sh fully passes. RED markers for both fixtures removed from .test-index.
data.title: GREEN: Compute holdout.txt partition from corpus
